notes: The booklet builds separate models. These are the red container, the grey container (with pallet, canisters and minifigure) and the container stacker truck. The red container is a genuinely separate model: the cover and every step show it standing alone, and nothing in the booklet attaches it to the truck or to the grey container. That is why the graph still has two groups of pieces. The grey container, pallet, canisters, minifigure, wrench and truck are linked only by rest-contact edges, where the cover picture shows them touching.
Stickers (hazard stripes, 'Max. 10 T', logo) are not modelled as parts.
Element IDs were read from the low-resolution inventory page. Some may be misread, for example 4211462, 4143953, 4211350, 4211470 and 4211479.

b105 uses type lego-9551. The inventory page prints only the 4-digit number 9551 for this white control piece, and the supplied catalogue already has an entry with that exact id. I kept the part because the booklet gives no longer element ID, and renaming it would be a guess.
Many pictures are small and ambiguous in the truck assembly. The pieces and counts follow the inventory page. Which neighbour each piece joins is a best guess in steps 7-30.
The inventory lists 4x 4142865 red axle extenders. I used all four, with two at the crane lifting arm and two at the boom pivot. The pictures seem to show more.
The inventory lists 6x 4121715 pins, but I could only place four. The other two are not placed.
The inventory lists 4x 4277928 brackets, but only three are visible in the steps, so one is not placed.

The inventory lists 4x 4211056 black 1x4 plates, and I used all four. Each container picture shows four black plates, which would need 8 in total. I used 4211056 for the red container and the grey container as pictured, so the counts may be off.
The red container uses four 4505067 panels and four 4210690 corner posts. The grey container uses two 4505068 panels. Placement is inferred from steps 3-5.

Port names were left null on most edges because the pieces' exact stud positions are not specified in the manual images. The liftarms b128 and b129 have only two modelled ports, so some of their joins use null ports.
The rear axle runs through the technic bricks at the red end of the chassis, and the front axle with four wheels runs through the technic bricks at the other end. This is inferred from steps 33-36.
